description: Build snow_connector_integration_review.py: a diagnostic that verifies snow_connector.py is properly wired into approval_workflow. The file must: (1) Read snow_connector.py and check it exposes handle_snow_webhook(payload: dict) -> dict; (2) Read approval_workflow.py and verify it imports or calls snow_connector; (3) Check for any HTTP calls between daemons (violation of spec section 5 - forbidden); (4) Report: {snow_built: bool, webhook_handler_present: bool, approval_workflow_imports: bool, inter_daemon_http: list, integration_status: str}. If integration_status != 'wired', the output suggests concrete wiring steps (e.g., 'approval_workflow.py line 45 should call snow_connector.handle_snow_webhook after decision write'). Exits 0. Diagnostic only, does not modify either file.
